title: Align descriptor test with bank-zero owner
changes: Update the earlier descriptor integration test for e99: pointer0 is now typed while bank0 row0 and the bank22 gap remain raw.
validation: The existing e99 focused Wine integration already proved poisoned pointer0 and adjacent owner composition as well as raw row0; the earlier acceptance was not replayed.
limitations: This is a test-only expectation update; the earlier test itself was not rerun. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
